hints.title: Pairwise XOR Multiplicity
hints.text: Every element in nums1 is paired with all elements in nums2, meaning each element of nums1 appears exactly len(nums2) times in the total xor sum.

hints.title: Self-Inverse Property
hints.text: Xor-ing any number with itself an even number of times yields 0. Thus, an element contributes to the final result only if its frequency is odd.

hints.title: Length Parity Evaluation
hints.text: If len(nums2) is odd, xor all elements of nums1 into the result. If len(nums1) is odd, xor all elements of nums2 into the result.

hints.title: Parity Reduced XOR Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan across each array based on length parity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n * m pairs yields quadratic O(n * m) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary memory accumulates bitwise operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies XOR involution property to avoid generating all pairwise terms.
